newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa brings 550 MW power plant on stream.
newsitem.headline: Endesa brings 550 MW power plant on stream.

text.p: Spain's Endesa has brought a new 550 megawatt coal-fired power plant in Almeria on stream after an investment of 57.67 billion pesetas, the firm said on Tuesday.

The plant is due to be connected to the national electricity network at the end of the month. When functional it will provide six percent of Spain's national electricity needs, approximately 1.6 billion kilowatts/hour, the firm said.
This will maintain its position as the biggest electricity generator in Spain, with a 47.3 percent market share, Endesa added.
